Supply Chain Planning Analyst
Switchgrass Freight Co., Kansas City, Missouri. Hybrid, three days a week in the office.

Switchgrass Freight moves less-than-truckload freight for 2,400 shippers across the Midwest. Our planning team forecasts freight volume by lane and by terminal so we can staff docks and place trailers before the freight shows up. Last year our forecasts missed by 24% on average, and a missed forecast means idle docks one day and overtime the next.

What you'll do
- Build and run weekly volume forecasts for 38 terminals.
- Find the lanes where forecasts miss most, and fix the inputs.
- Turn forecasts into dock staffing and trailer plans with the operations team.
- Report forecast accuracy every week to terminal managers.

Requirements
- Bachelor's degree in supply chain, business, analytics or a related field.
- Three or more years in demand planning, supply planning or forecasting.
- Advanced Excel, including pivot tables and lookups, and working SQL.
- Experience with a transportation or warehouse management system.
- Clear written updates for people who don't work with data.

Preferred
- Power BI or Tableau.
- Experience in less-than-truckload or other freight.

Pay: $72,000 to $88,000 a year.
